title: BPW-2026-0530
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0530
CD 4
MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (MOU) – GLENDALE LOS ANGELES GARDEN RIVER BRIDGE PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE the proposed MOU between the City of Los Angeles and the City of Glendale (Glendale) to support Glendale’s planning, construction, operation, and maintenance of the Glendale-Los Angeles Garden River Bridge Project; and
AUTHORIZE the President or two members of the Board to execute the MOU.
(W.O.: BR004998)
